family.description: This family includes human Transmembrane protein 250 (TM250) and similar proteins from vertebrates. TM250 is involved in cellular processes related to cell proliferation, specifically by aiding the transition into the S phase of the cell cycle. Additionally, it has a role in viral pathogenesis, as it is known to enhance the proliferation of human herpes simplex virus 1 (HHV-1) [[cite:PUB00155240]].
family.name: Transmembrane protein 250
